kep.title: Kep
lines: Toss from behind the line at the hole.
In the hole scores 3, closest scores 2, next closest 1.
Five rounds. The highest total wins.

batto.title: Batto
lines: Everyone tosses at hole 1. The closest goes first.
Race to hole 1, 2, 3, then back through 2 to 1.
Reach the hole you are heading for, or hit a rival, and shoot again.

guli.title: Guli Khela
lines: Everyone pays a stake and tosses. The closest scatters the stake round the hole.
Tap the marble you must not touch: the baad. Then throw.
Touch exactly one other marble to win the ground.
Touch the baad, or more than one, and pay a fine of one marble.

quick.title: Quick Dan
lines: Tap the baad, then touch exactly one other marble to win the ground.
The match ends when the dan is won.
